purpose: Complete agency Astro lifecycle: Day-1 greenfield starter, multi-framework repo auditing, live/Firecrawl capture, asset localization, Astro v7 scaffolding, Day-2 article publishing and safe updating, regression manifest gating, Visual Digital Twin parity checks, build verification, and a source-cited knowledge vault.

discovery.setup: Python 3.11+ and Node.js 22.23.4+ (LTS 24.15.0 recommended). Optional Playwright runtime for `twin`. Offline doctor, source-audit, ingest/scaffold preview, verify-build, twin-diff, and docs-lookup require no credentials.
discovery.not_for: Provisioning cloud servers, reverse proxies, or DNS records; executing untrusted astro.config.mjs files during read-only inspection.
examples: Convert my WordPress export or static HTML pages to an Astro v7 site and verify parity
Start a new Astro agency, blog, or local business starter site
Publish this Markdown article to my Astro blog and verify nothing else broke
Update an Astro post or rename its slug with a 301 redirect
Check why my Astro v7 build broke client scripts, styles, trailing slashes, or content collections
Audit an existing site before migrating to Astro and verify the built dist folder afterward
Attach the Astro v7 knowledge pack to my Empire vault

scope: Portable Python and Node CLI for Astro v7 readiness, Day-1 greenfield agency starter (init, scaffold --mode starter), multi-framework repository auditing (Next.js, Nuxt, Gatsby, Vite/CRA, Docusaurus, Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, SvelteKit), live HTTP/Firecrawl capture, two-pass asset localization (vendor-assets), preview-first clone/editorial/starter scaffolding (scaffold/ingest), Day-2 article publishing and safe updating (post), post-build dist/ parity and regression manifest verification (verify-build --baseline/--write-manifest), Playwright Visual Digital Twin diffing (twin/twin-diff), pinned withastro/docs lookup, and attachable Empire knowledge pack.
